final_message:
All tests pass now! The fix involved two changes to the `slugify` function:

1. Changed the regex from `[^a-z0-9]` to `[^a-z0-9]+` to replace consecutive non-alphanumeric characters with a single dash instead of multiple dashes
2. Added `.strip("-")` to remove any leading or trailing dashes that might result from the substitution

This ensures "  a   b  " becomes "a-b" instead of "a---b", and "C++ rocks!" becomes "c-rocks" instead of "c---rocks-".
